title: VPC & On-Prem Install — Cross-Customer Sync + Risk Register (Sept 2026)
content:
Context and purpose:
This doc captures the cross-customer weekly sync (09/10–09/17) for VPC and on-prem installs. Focus is to consolidate blockers that require cross-team escalation, maintain a lightweight risk register, and list immediate actions for next week. Use this as the single source for handoffs into Solutions Eng and SRE.

Meeting logistics:
- Weekly sync cadence: Thu 09:00 PT (recurring)
- Attendees: Aisha (PM lead), Carlos (SE lead), Lina (Installer), Tom (Network), Maya (SRE), Kate (Security for part of meeting)
- Quick goal: Identify 1) escalations needing exec attention, 2) customers at risk of missing SLA, 3) infra/dependency gaps to remediate.

Top-line summary:
- Active installs: 6 (3 on VPC, 3 on-prem).
- New P0 this week: one customer (FinServeX) with persistent KV cache warmup failures causing 40% increase in cold-start latency; currently throttling client traffic.
- Air-gapped install (MedixHealth) progressed: golden image transfer succeeded but HSM provisioning delayed by vendor SLA.
- Networking: two customers require /26 allocations and MTU tuning; one datacenter has non-standard MTU (9000) which broke jumbo-frame assumptions.
- Security: customer-signed cert rotation schedule needed for 11/01 cutover; gating for production per security review.

Per-customer notes (concise):
1) FinServeX (on-prem, brownfield colo)
   - Symptoms: cold-start token latency spikes (x1.4) after weekly reboot; KV cache warming incomplete; intermittent TLS handshake timeouts from their edge LB to our inference nodes.
   - Root hypotheses: (a) KV cache config mismatch (prefix caching disabled by default on their environment), (b) TCP RSTs due to MTU mismatch and LB healthcheck timeouts.
   - Actions in-flight: Lina to run post-reboot cache-warm script (PD-4721) and post results by 2026-09-13. Tom to validate MTU and MTU-related drops with colo provider by 2026-09-14. Maya to enable extended tracing for handshake timeouts (logs go to pd-install-traces).
   - Risk/impact: high. If unresolved, customer will throttle to 50% traffic on 09/20 (contract clause).

2) MedixHealth (air-gapped on-prem)
   - Progress: Golden VM image copied via approved courier, intake checksum verified.
   - Blocker: HSM token provisioning delayed — third-party vendor ETA 09/21 for hardware keys. Without HSM we cannot complete KMS integration and FIPS validation.
   - Mitigation: Temporary local KMS with strict audit enabled to allow staging acceptance tests. Security approved temporary measure pending HSM delivery (see CONFLUENCE link).
   - Owner: Carlos (coordinate with vendor).

3) OptiRetail (VPC, multi-az)
   - Issue: Route tables not propagating to secondary AZ causing failover mismatch; canary traffic showed 7% error increase on AZ failover.
   - Fix: Redeploy route propagation via terraform change in PR #89; scheduled apply 09/15 after maintenance window.
   - Owner: Infrastructure (PR owner: Lina).

4) NimbusBank (on-prem, regulated)
   - Security ask: Customer requires documented certificate rotation runbook + test result demonstration. Security needs test evidence by 09/24 to meet internal audit.
   - Action: Aisha + Security to produce runbook snippets and sample rotated certs in staging by 09/20.

5) EdgeCo (edge appliances)
   - Observed: Occasional GPU driver mismatch during kernel updates causing service restarts.
   - Temporary workaround: Pin driver version to 535.84 across fleet; release engineering to create image patch by 09/16.

6) AtlasLogistics (VPC with private capacity)
   - Customer requested lower-cost quantized model variant for bulk rerank workload. Product approved canary but runtime needs new kernel selection tweak.
   - Action: Serving-runtime to enable quantized kernel in canary pool; expected rollout 09/22.

Risk register (top 6 prioritized) — (owner, likelihood, impact, mitigation, status):
- R1: HSM vendor slippage (MedixHealth) — Owner: Carlos; Likelihood: Medium-High; Impact: High (blocks go-live); Mitigation: temporary local KMS w/ audit; Status: open.
- R2: KV cache misconfiguration causing client SLA breach (FinServeX) — Owner: Lina; Likelihood: High; Impact: High; Mitigation: run cache-warm script + MTU validation; Status: active.
- R3: Cert rotation audit gap (NimbusBank) — Owner: Aisha; Likelihood: Medium; Impact: Medium-High; Mitigation: produce runbook + demo; Status: open.
- R4: Network provider route propagation bug (OptiRetail) — Owner: Tom; Likelihood: Medium; Impact: Medium; Mitigation: terraform fix + scheduled apply; Status: scheduled.
- R5: Edge GPU driver drift (EdgeCo) — Owner: Release Eng; Likelihood: Medium; Impact: Medium; Mitigation: image pin + patch; Status: in_progress.
- R6: Telemetry retention gap for private installs (cross-customer) — Owner: Maya; Likelihood: Medium; Impact: Low-Medium; Mitigation: increase retention for pd-install-traces to 90d for critical buckets; Status: proposal.

Decisions made this week:
- Approve temporary local KMS for MedixHealth staging tests (Security conditional approval on audit logs).
- Defer full HSM integration verification until vendor certificate chain confirmed; temporary acceptance criteria documented in Confluence.
- Enable quantized-kernel canary for AtlasLogistics to measure unit-cost impact before full rollout.

Actions and owners (short list):
- Lina: Execute PD-4721 cache-warm runbook against FinServeX on 09/13 and post perf digests. DUE 2026-09-13.
- Tom: Validate MTU settings with colo provider and share packet drop evidence. DUE 2026-09-14.
- Carlos: Follow up with HSM vendor escalation; request expedited provisioning or loaner HSM. Update 09/15.
- Maya: Turn on extended TLS handshake traces for FinServeX and increase pd-install-traces retention to 90 days for critical spans. DUE 09/14.
- Aisha + Security: Draft cert rotation runbook for NimbusBank and schedule demo with customer. DUE 09/20.
- Release Eng: Produce pinned image patch for EdgeCo drivers and submit canary rollout plan. DUE 09/16.

Open questions for execs / need for escalation:
- Do we approve budget for rented HSM hardware if vendor cannot meet dates? (Estimated cost: $12k for 30-day loaner across region) — ask to Ops Finance.
- Legal: confirm acceptability of temporary local KMS in contract annex for MedixHealth.

Metrics snapshot (week):
- Average install lead time (from intake to first inference): 10.5 days (target 7 days).
- Installs completed this week: 2 (one VPC, one on-prem staging).
- P0 incidents opened: 1 (FinServeX).

Notes to self / rough ideas:
- Consider a small automated preflight MTU check script to detect jumbo frame mismatches before golden image deployment. Could be part of onboarding checklist.
- Add an HSM contingency clause to standard install SOWs (loaner or milestone-based acceptance).
- Explore temporary KMS proxy pattern for air-gapped installs that want audit but can’t wait on vendor HSM.

Next meeting and expectations:
- Next weekly sync: Thu 09/17 09:00 PT. Expect status updates on PD-4721 run, HSM vendor ETA, and cert runbook draft.
- If FinServeX SLA risk remains high after 09/14 checks, schedule an emergency escalations call and consider short-term traffic shaping to avoid contract breach.

Appendix (quick links and artifacts):
- PD runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PD/Install+Playbook
- Traces bucket: pd-install-traces (SRE internal retention policy ticket PD-4799)
- Jira tickets referenced: PD-4721, PD-4799, PD-4804

End of doc.
